task_instance: Created a small sample ASP.NET Core Web API (Program.cs with global camelCase JSON policy, an OrdersController with POST /api/orders and GET /api/orders/{id:guid}, and CreateOrderRequest/OrderResponse DTOs) plus a hand-written TypeScript fetch client (orderService.ts) that had deliberately drifted from it (missing a newly-required ShippingAddress field, a renamed response field total->totalAmount, and an unhandled new 409 status code). Performed the skill's full process by reading the C# and TypeScript source directly (no OpenAPI spec files involved): discovered the global JSON naming policy, extracted the controller route surface and DTO shapes with required/optional rules, matched them to the TS client via normalized URL matching, and compared both directions (backend->client breaks and client->backend drift), producing a scannable audit report with match-confidence labeling per the skill's Output Format.
evidence: Sample project created under backend/ (Program.cs, Controllers/OrdersController.cs, Dtos/OrderDtos.cs) and frontend/src/orderService.ts. Performed the skill's static-analysis process directly on this source (this skill's deliverable is an LLM-authored analysis report, not code execution or a bundled script/tool -- the SKILL.md describes a pure read-source-and-report workflow with no scripts, SDKs, or external services referenced). Verified correctness by manually cross-checking each finding against the source: (1) CreateOrderRequest.ShippingAddress is a C# 11 'required' property with no client-side counterpart in CreateOrderPayload -- confirmed via grep showing only customerName/quantity are sent; (2) OrderResponse.TotalAmount vs client's expected 'total' field -- confirmed by reading both DTO and TS interface; (3) controller's [ProducesResponseType(409)] vs client's error handling only checking status 400/500 -- confirmed by reading OrdersController.cs and the createOrder() status checks; (4) both endpoints matched to consumers via normalized route comparison (/api/orders and /api/orders/{id:guid} vs template-string URLs in orderService.ts), so 'No Consumer Found' section is empty as expected. Full audit written to api_contract_audit.md covering all 5 required Output Format sections: Scope Audited, Backend->Client Breaks, Client->Backend Drift, No Consumer Found, Match Confidence Summary.
